graph_rich_club — CONNGRAPH stats op

• Data kinds: conn_graph → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.graph_rich_club(W: 'Any', k: 'int') -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import conngraph; conngraph.graph_rich_club(W: 'Any', k: 'int') -> 'float'; from the registry, opsconngraph.get("graph_rich_club"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

rich club 係数 φ(k): 総次数 (in+out、二値) > k のノードが張る部分グラフの有向密度。

φ = 辺数 / (r (r − 1))、r = 該当ノード数。r < 2 なら 0(NaN を返さない)。
